Title: Dizzy After Wegovy, Zepbound, or Mounjaro? Here's Why

Description:
Dizziness on GLP-1 weight-loss injections usually comes down to three things: appetite suppression lowering your blood sugar, nausea and diarrhea draining fluids and sodium, and rapid weight loss dropping your blood pressure. Eat small, protein-rich meals often, add electrolytes instead of just water, and check your blood pressure regularly if you're on BP medication.
